topology: two independent materialized mirrors plus a third VM hosting the real Relayfile service; HTTPS preview ingress; no shared drive or volume
cpu_allocation: Not separately configured; visible CPU observations in health.json are not a reserved-core guarantee.
binary_vcs_modified_note: Build metadata reports modified=true. The tracked working-tree difference was .trajectories/index.json, with no tracked Go source changes; executable SHA-256 values identify the exact artifacts.
provider_writeback: Built-in OSS no-op provider writer; no external provider mutations.
clock: writer time.monotonic_ns(), before open(wb) to matching SHA-256 ACK received at writer
payload: Unique round header followed by repeated bytes 0..255, truncated to exact size; deterministic compressible binary content.
operations: Sequential ordinary open/write/close overwrites of one dedicated file per direction and size. No fsync.
ack_transport: Python urllib HTTPS POST via peer preview, fresh request; includes return transport/TLS/ingress and observer/hash costs.
